L'Unité organisation territoriale (UOT) de la Direction générale de la cohésion sociale (DGCS), contribue à la réflexion et au pilotage de l'organisation des prestations sociales sur le territoire cantonal.

Elle analyse les besoins des différentes régions, coordonne les acteurs concernés et accompagne la mise en œuvre et l'évolution des dispositifs sociaux, en veillant à leur cohérence et à leur accessibilité pour la population.

Elle a également pour mission d'assurer une vision cohérente transverse pour le parc immobilier subventionné par la DGCS qui comprend notamment l'hébergement médico-social (EMS, EPSM, ESE) et les ateliers à vocation productive, soit environ 400 bâtiments gérés par 250 partenaires.
Afin de mener un projet ambitieux visant à établir une stratégie pour la mise aux normes énergétiques et d'adaptation aux conséquences du réchauffement climatique du parc immobilier de la structure socio-sanitaire, l'Unité organisation territoriale (UOT) recherche **un·e Chef·fe de projet Plan climat.**

* Structurer et mettre en place de la phase 1 du projet DSAS-1 du plan climat vaudois de 2ème génération œuvrant à faire un état des lieux du parc immobilier accueillant des populations vulnérables et subventionné par la DGCS.
* Piloter la phase 1 du projet DSAS-1 du plan climat vaudois (EMPD 24 LEG 168) et en assurer l-avancement selon le calendrier prévu et l-enveloppe budgétaire dédiée.

* Coconstruire les réflexions avec l-équipe UOT sur les questions de transition énergétique, durabilité et climat, et être activement partie prenante aux réflexions collectives de l-équipe et du service sur ces thématiques.

As a Senior Project Manager in the Professional Services Excellence team, you turn our most important priorities into well-structured, well-run initiatives that improve how PS works, collaborates, and delivers. You bring clarity, ownership, and strong execution discipline to complex problems, helping PS move from intention to reality and making sure improvements land across regions and teams.
This is an execution and strategy role, not a coordination one. You shape direction as much as you drive it: pressure-testing which initiatives matter, framing the problem, and then owning delivery end to end.

You connect strategy to action by creating structure where it is missing, driving alignment across stakeholders, and ensuring new ways of working are adopted, not just launched. This is also a founding role on a new team, so you will help shape how the function operates and where it focuses first, not step into a fixed playbook.
Your scope is global. You will work on efforts expected to impact the global team, collaborating with leaders and team members across regions and influencing stakeholders across time zones. Your impact will show up in strong execution on our strategic priorities, clearer processes that reduce friction, and more time for PS teams to focus on delivering value to customers.

Drive execution and deliver meaningful change
Translate PS priorities into clear, structured plans with timelines, milestones, dependencies, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
Lead end-to-end delivery of PS-wide and cross-domain initiatives, keeping them moving and making sure they land in operations.
Bring strong change management discipline so new processes, workflows, and tools are adopted across teams and achieve their intended results.
Remove blockers, create alignment, and make sure stakeholders know what is needed from them at every stage.
Shape priorities and provide leverage to PS leadership
Pressure-test priorities with leadership: assess where the biggest gaps, risks, and opportunities sit, and bring a clear point of view on where to focus.
Turn strategy and broad goals into actionable plans, helping leadership move from intent to execution.
Surface risks, trade-offs, and progress clearly, enabling better and faster decisions.
Coordinate work across regions and domains so PS operates as one team rather than isolated verticals.
Improve how PS operates
Identify inefficiencies or gaps in how we work, and design improvements that raise consistency, scalability, and delivery quality.
Partner with analytics partners to define metrics, measure impact, and validate that initiatives drive real results.
Drive adoption and follow-through on improvements that reduce friction and give PS teams more time for customer impact.
Partner with tooling owners so our tools match how we work and change lands cleanly across PS.

You bring senior-level judgment, maturity, and presence, whether you are a strong L2 stepping up in scope or already operating at Senior level.

You enjoy working with a wide range of stakeholders and lifting teams through better processes, clearer workflows, and structured execution.
About the PS Excellence team
Purpose & mission
As Professional Services scales, the way we work needs to scale with us. Scaling brings more complexity, more teams, more stakeholders, and a higher bar for quality and consistency. Without the right structures in place, we end up reacting to change instead of shaping it, fixing the same problems repeatedly, and spending too much time on low leverage work instead of what we do best: delivering industry leading customer experiences at scale.
The PS Excellence team exists to solve these challenges at the root and build the capabilities PS needs to be successful at scale. Our mission is to build the systems, insights and capabilities that allow PS to deliver consistently, efficiently, and with confidence, as we grow.

Results from a recent PS survey shows that 70% of the team spends fewer than 40% of their time on projects with customers. If we get this right, we expect to materially increase the time our teams can focus on high value customer interactions.
The PS Excellence team is fully part of Professional Services, sitting close to the team members delivering with customers every day. This ensures that the team is close to the every day interactions of our team, and able to understand and respond to customer and team delivery

Job Description
At Olsson, we are passionate about improving communities through expert engineering and design. Our people are our greatest asset, and we are committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make an impact.
Our Data Center team delivers multidisciplinary engineering and design services for some of the world's most innovative companies. These projects represent some of the largest and most complex infrastructure developments in the country, creating opportunities to solve challenging problems, collaborate across disciplines, and shape the facilities that support global connectivity.
We are seeking a Construction Administration Project Manager to help guide large-scale data center projects through the construction phase. In this role, you will connect design intent with field execution, coordinate across multidisciplinary teams, and help keep construction-phase decisions, documentation, and deliverables moving forward.

You will build trusted relationships with clients and project partners while supporting quality, safety, schedule, and successful project closeout. This role supports construction administration across data center projects and includes travel to project sites as needed for observations, meetings, and project coordination.

Serve as a primary connection between Olsson's design team, client representatives, contractors, consultants, and other project stakeholders during construction.
Coordinate construction-phase documentation, including requests for information, shop drawings, submittals, substitution requests, design packages, and related project records.
Review documentation for cross-discipline coordination, completeness, quality, and alignment with the design intent and contract documents.
Evaluate design changes and field conditions, coordinate technical input from the appropriate disciplines , and help assess potential effects on scope, schedule, and budget.
Lead or participate in project meetings, communicate decisions and action items, and follow through with the design team and project partners.
Track project progress, outstanding items, risks, and upcoming milestones while maintaining accurate and organized records.
Support project financial management through invoice coordination, change management, and monitoring of project budgets and schedules.
Conduct site observations as needed to monitor progress, identify potential deficiencies, and communicate findings to the appropriate parties .
Coordinate the resolution of technical and site-specific issues to help minimize rework, delays, and disruptions.
Support project closeout, including punch-list activities, final testing and commissioning coordination, record documents, and final deliverables.

Working collaboratively with others.
Having ownership in the work you do.
Using your talents to positively affect communities.

4+ years of experience within the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry with increasing project responsibilities.
2+ years of project management, construction management, or construction administration experience, which may be concurrent with overall project experience.
Understanding of engineering and design terminology, construction processes, contracts, project financials, and relevant codes.
Strong communication , organization, time management, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to build effective relationships, navigate challenging conversations, and resolve issues across project teams.
Experience with Microsoft Office and construction management platforms. Experience with Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Newforma, Smartsheet, or similar tools is beneficial.
Commitment to exceptional client service, quality, and safety.

## Chargé(e) de projets / Planificateur(trice) Sanitaire ##
### Notre bureau ###
**Conti & Associés Ingénieurs SA** est un bureau d-ingénieurs spécialisé dans les techniques du bâtiment **CVSER**, implanté à **Versoix (Genève)** et **Perroy (Vaud)**.
Actifs depuis 1983, nous regroupons aujourd-hui plus de 35 collaborateurs et intervenons dans les domaines suivants :
· Chauffage, ventilation et climatisation (CVC)
· Sanitaire
· Électricité
· Régulation / MCR et automatisme du bâtiment
Nous accompagnons nos clients sur l-ensemble des phases **SIA 108**, avec une activité importante sur les phases 3, 4 et 5 : études, appels d-offres, réalisation et réception des ouvrages. Nous intervenons également en phase 6 pour le suivi de l-exploitation et l-optimisation énergétique des bâtiments.
Notre activité couvre aussi les audits et diagnostics énergétiques, la physique du bâtiment, les études de faisabilité CVSER, les CECB+, les missions GED et AMOén dans le cadre du programme éco21, ainsi que les expertises techniques CVSER pour des assurances, maîtres d-ouvrage ou dans le cadre de procédures judiciaires.
### Le poste ###
Dans le cadre du développement de notre département Sanitaire, nous recherchons un(e) **Chargé(e) de projets / Planificateur(trice) Sanitaire** capable de participer à la conception et au suivi de projets variés, de l'étude jusqu'à la réalisation.
### Vos missions ###
1/ **Études et conception**
a/ Concevoir et dimensionner les installations sanitaires conformément aux normes, directives et règles de l-art applicables en Suisse.
b/ Réaliser les études des réseaux d-eau froide, eau chaude sanitaire, bouclage, eaux usées et eaux pluviales.
c/ Réaliser les calculs et dimensionnements nécessaires aux projets.
d/ Élaborer les plans, schémas de principe et détails techniques.
2/ **Plans et soumissions**
a/ Réaliser et mettre à jour les plans sanitaires sous **AutoCAD 2D**.
b/ Établir les quantitatifs et métrés nécessaires aux appels d-offres.
c/ Participer à l-élaboration des **soumissions CAN** à l-aide des outils spécifiques tels que **Plancal Nova / SNAP**.
d/ Participer à l-analyse technique des offres des entreprises.
3/ **Coordination et réalisation**
a/ Assurer la coordination technique avec les disciplines chauffage, ventilation, électricité et régulation.
b/ Participer aux séances avec les maîtres d-ouvrage, architectes, entreprises et autres mandataires.
c/ Participer au suivi de l-exécution des installations sur le terrain.
d/ Contrôler la conformité des installations avec les plans, normes et prescriptions du projet.
e/ Participer aux réceptions des installations et au suivi des réserves.
### Votre profil ###
1/ **Formation et expérience**
a/ CFC de projeteur(se) en technique du bâtiment sanitaire, technicien(ne) ES, maîtrise fédérale ou formation jugée équivalente.
b/ Expérience de plusieurs années dans un bureau d-ingénieurs, bureau d'études ou une entreprise sanitaire.
c/ Une expérience professionnelle en Suisse constitue un avantage important.
2/ **Compétences techniques**
a/ Bonne maîtrise d-**AutoCAD 2D**.
b/ Connaissance de **Plancal Nova / SNAP** et des soumissions selon le **CAN sanitaire**.
c/ Bonne connaissance des normes et prescriptions sanitaires suisses.
d/ Connaissance des prescriptions **SSIGE** et des directives techniques **Geberit**.
e/ La maîtrise de **Revit / BIM** constitue un atout.
f/ Bonne maîtrise des outils MS Office.
### Vos qualités ###

s.h: Nous recherchons avant tout une personne
s.t:
· autonome dans les missions correspondant à son niveau d'expérience ;
· pragmatique et à l-aise avec la réalité du terrain
· capable de prendre des initiatives et des responsabilités
· appréciant le travail en équipe et les échanges entre disciplines
· ayant envie de progresser et de s-investir durablement dans notre bureau.
Selon votre expérience et votre degré d-autonomie, le poste pourra évoluer vers davantage de responsabilités et la gestion complète de projets sanitaires.

WorkWave is a leading provider of SaaS solutions, helping businesses streamline their operations and drive growth through innovative technology. As we continue to expand, we are looking for an experienced Project Manager to join our Global Professional Services team. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting our Professional Services and Delivery teams by managing customer relationships, scoping billable projects, and developing clear, impactful statements of work.
Operating as a critical member of our global team, this role owns the execution of a diverse project portfolio. This role requires an adaptable leader who can seamlessly shift gears: running highly structured, complex enterprise software deployments (e.g., Time & Attendance, Payroll, Finance) while efficiently driving higher-velocity, smaller application rollouts.
This role demands an exceptional blend of professional maturity, meticulous time management across NA time zones, and the acute attention to detail required to protect project margins. You will bring structure to ambiguity, ensuring that every tier of client—from enterprise corporations to smaller accounts—experiences a world-class onboarding journey.

AI-Driven Efficiency: Champion the adoption of internal AI and automation tools to streamline project tracking, synthesize meeting data across time zones, and accelerate the creation of project documentation and status reports.
Strategic On-Site Presence : Travel domestically (up to 25%) to lead critical kick-off meetings, conduct high-stakes steering committee reviews, and foster deep, trust-based relationships with global enterprise clients and distributed teams.
Global Stakeholder Management: Establish, maintain, and navigate complex relationships with international stakeholders, delivery teams, and cross-border customers.
Scope & Detail Analysis: Define or deeply analyze project scopes, impacts, resource allocations, and localized outcomes, ensuring meticulous attention to detail before gaining customer alignment.
Precision Project Planning: Develop granular project plans, mapping out dependencies and scheduling project activities across multiple time zones.
Time Management & Execution: Rigorously track the progress of all concurrent workstreams, keeping a sharp eye on deadlines to ensure commitments are met punctually.
Transparent Communication: Deliver precise and thoroughly documented project progress updates to delivery teams, sponsors, board members, and clients.
Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify, track, and resolve emerging risks and localized issues promptly and professionally, escalating where necessary.
Standards & Documentation: Utilize appropriate project management systems, tools, and methodologies while maintaining flawless, audit-ready project documentation.
Financial & Project Closure: Methodically close projects to enable revenue recognition, ensuring all final details are accounted for and global lessons learned are thoroughly reviewed.

Experience: 5+ years of dedicated Project Management experience, ideally managing global IT (software) and SaaS deployments.
AI Fluency: Demonstrated experience using AI-powered tools, including project management software, generative AI tools, or predictive analytics to enhance resource scheduling, risk forecasting, and stakeholder communication.
Methodology: Proven experience working within structured project management frameworks (e.g., PRINCE2, PMP).
Track Record: Documented success in delivering complex projects strictly on budget and on time, meeting or exceeding project revenue targets.
Time Management & Detail Orientation: Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, tight international deadlines, and complex project minutiae without sacrificing quality.
Communication & Negotiation : Exceptional written, verbal, facilitation, and negotiation skills, with a high cultural awareness for global communication.
Commercial Acumen: Demonstrable experience in commercial decision-making and managing project profitability.
Interpersonal Skills: Excellent interpersonal skills with a natural ability to quickly build trust and rapport with diverse, cross-functional, and remote international teams.
Tools & Platforms: High proficiency with modern project management tools and collaboration platforms (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheets, MS Office, G-Suite).

Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) is a single-threaded organization that owns the end-to-end customer experience for heavy and bulky products, from supply chain and fulfillment through transportation, last mile delivery, and post-purchase resolution. AMXL currently operates across North America, Europe, Japan, and is expanding into emerging markets.

Within AMXL, the CX and Growth org is a centralized, worldwide team organized across five pillars designed to ensure that every customer who purchases a large, high-value product receives a reliable experience.
The Execution Excellence pillar is where planning meets the customer. It houses two complementary teams: our AMXL Operations Center and our AMXL Proactive Execution program.

These teams serve as the real-time network execution backbone, translating strategic decisions into daily network performance across our end-to-end network and also as the mechanism that identifies delivery failures before they become visible to the customer and intervenes proactively to save the delivery or manage the recovery directly with the customer.

Together, these teams form a closed loop: detect upstream, prevent where possible, intervene proactively where not, and feed root causes back so defects are resolved at the source.
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead the integration and transformation of this combined organization. This is not a steady-state program management role. The program strategy is being built.

You will inherit a consolidation in progress and own the lifecycle of making it work: assessing what the combined org should look like, defining how we measure success, building the mechanisms that make it sustainable, and driving the hard conversations required to get there.

You will use process lifecycle evaluation methodologies to categorize the team's portfolio (automate, simplify, reallocate, or deprecate), and build automation roadmaps in partnership with technical teams.
This role requires someone who can operate in high ambiguity, make trade-offs between short-term operational needs and long-term strategic goals, and communicate persuasively across teams. The right candidate sees automation and AI as something they use today, not something they plan to use later, and will set the standard for how this team uses technology to scale impact without scaling headcount.

· Define the operating model for the combined organization: org design, process rationalization, scope definition, and mechanisms that make it self-sustaining.
· Build the process lifecycle evaluation framework, determining which workflows to automate, simplify, reallocate, or retire, and manage the pipeline of new use cases from scoping through launch.
· Own the automation roadmap in partnership with data science, engineering, and technology teams, establishing accountability mechanisms with clear timelines for every manual process.
· Drive cross-functional stakeholder alignment across supply chain, quality, and operations, navigating complex organizational dynamics and building trust where needed.
· Scale this capability into new geographies by adapting the operating model to local carrier ecosystems, regulatory environments, and workforce availability.
A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing program metrics dashboards, identifying areas that need attention, and preparing a status narrative for a director-level review. By mid-morning you are facilitating a working session with partners to align on priorities for the quarter.

After lunch you dive into data to validate assumptions behind a proposed solution, then draft a decision document that frames trade-offs for leadership. You close the day mentoring a newer program manager and connecting with cross-regional counterparts to keep workstreams on track.

As an IT Program Manager (Service Designer), GS-2210-15, you will be responsible for: Leading discovery and design efforts rooted in empathy for students, families, and financial aid administrators. Ensuring FSA services are intuitive and accessible to users of all backgrounds, and that every interaction builds trust and confidence in the program.

Looking beyond the screen to understand and improve the end-to-end journey of applying for and receiving aid, mapping processes, policies, and touchpoints across agencies and partners, identifying pain points and opportunities for more seamless, equitable services.

Designing solutions that account for the full ecosystem, not just individual transactions. Leading usability testing with diverse users, incorporating feedback into design iterations. Ensuring that final solutions can scale to millions of FSA users while maintaining clarity, accessibility, and reliability.

Championing design to drive organizational change, challenging outdated processes and building alignment across stakeholders. Proactively pushing through barriers to user-focused innovation and modeling a bias for action to unlock better outcomes for students and families within a complex federal environment.

Working hand-in-hand with product managers, engineers, policy experts, and contractors to ensure design decisions are fully integrated into development.

Mentoring others in human-centered and service design practices, elevating the organization's overall design maturity and building a culture that values design as essential to delivering public services that work for everyone.
Minimum Qualification Requirements You may meet the minimum qualifications for the GS-15, if you possess the specialize experience.

Specialized Experience for the GS-15 One year of experience in either federal or non-federal service that is equivalent to at least a GS-14 performing two (2) out of three (3) of the following duties or work assignments: 1.

Experience leading or serving in a senior role of a multi-disciplinary project involving the design, development, and implementation of a new system or a major enhancement to an existing IT system. 2. Experience serving as a design lead, overseeing adoption of new functionalities and/or technologies for users. 3.

Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences and translating business requirements into technical user stories.

Basic Experience Requirements: Applicants may qualify by meeting or exceeding the minimum proficiency level established for each of the required competencies, in addition to meeting the specialized experience requirement as demonstrated through the assessment of skills.

You must possess IT-related experience (paid or unpaid experience and/or completion of specific, intensive training (e.g., IT certification), as appropriate) demonstrating each of the nine competencies listed below. Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (i.e., any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Decision Making - Makes sound, well-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals; causes change.

Information Management - Identifies a need for and knows where or how to gather information; organizes and maintains information or information management systems.

Interpersonal Skills- Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, concern, and politeness to others; develops and maintains effective relationships with others; may include effectively dealing with individuals who are difficult, hostile, or distressed; relates well to people from varied backgrounds and different situations.

Oral Communication- Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving- Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. Teamwork- Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and group identity; fosters commitment and team spirit; works with others to achieve goals.

Technical Competence- Uses knowledge that is acquired through formal training or on-the-job experience to perform one's job; works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job; advises others on technical issues.

Skill human-centered design and user experience methods.

Skill in service design and systems thinking. Skill in prototyping, testing, and iterating solutions at scale. Skill in navigating bureaucracy and driving design-led change. Ability to collaborate across disciplines and build a culture of design.
